title: SEC6: goto-done cleanup pattern throughout
description: Every function that acquires resources (op_fd from pool, heap-allocated ctx, mutex) uses a goto-done pattern with a single cleanup block at the label. This is appropriate for the C89 target: it avoids duplicating XFREE/close/pool_release calls on every error path; it is idiomatic in wolfSSL's own codebase; and it eliminates a class of resource-leak bugs that arise when early-return paths miss one of several cleanup steps. The pattern is applied consistently across crypto2dev_cipher(), crypto2dev_hash(), crypto2dev_hmac(), crypto2dev_key_import(), and the TLS integration test functions.
